cards.meaning: to spike; to jump suddenly (literally, to kick)
cards.example: Sumipa ang implasyon sa 7.2% noong Setyembre.
cards.note: Pang-ulat at ginagamit sa titulo ng balita; may kasamang gulat. Mas biglaan kaysa 'tumaas', mas mahinahon kaysa 'sumirit'.
cards.tiesTo: September inflation at 7.2% and BSP's October forecast band

cards.meaning: to scrutinize closely; to go over line by line
cards.example: Babusisiin ng mga senador ang badyet para sa 2027.
cards.exampleMeaning: The senators will scrutinize the 2027 budget.
cards.note: Pormal; ginagamit sa pera ng gobyerno. Mas matiyaga at may pagdududa kaysa 'suriin'.
cards.tiesTo: Senate review of the P7.2T 2027 budget and lump-sum provisions

cards.example: 哪怕高科技制造业的指数高于50,整体也仍在收缩。
cards.examplePinyin: Nǎpà gāokējì zhìzàoyè de zhǐshù gāoyú wǔshí, zhěngtǐ yě réng zài shōusuō.
cards.exampleMeaning: Even if the high-tech manufacturing index is above 50, the overall picture is still contracting.
cards.note: 介于口语和书面语之间;比'即使……也……'更生动、更强调极端情况。第二分句常用'也'或'都'。 Register: between spoken and written; punchier than 即使.
cards.tiesTo: China October PMI 49.3 with high-tech still above 50

cards.example: 数据好转不见得意味着经济复苏。
cards.examplePinyin: Shùjù hǎozhuǎn bú jiàn de yìwèizhe jīngjì fùsū.
cards.exampleMeaning: Better data doesn't necessarily mean the economy is recovering.
cards.note: 口语;比书面语的'未必'更随意。Colloquial hedge; 未必 is the more formal near-synonym.
cards.tiesTo: Two-speed China: new-economy strength is not necessarily a recovery
